notes.title: Updated on March 31st
notes.content:
Fix bug:
When exiting and re entering the external growth interface, the detailed introduction information viewed from the previous exit will be retained
When rushing in front of the mirror in the main city, the "swordsman" in the mirror will revert back to the witch's own bug
After pressing the Start button on the 3.3 Select 1 interface, the UI interface becomes disorganized when returning
4. Props can only display tens of digits. I have more than ten, but there is no problem with displaying single digit numbers
5. When exiting and re entering the external growth interface, if you exit from the option in row 234, the up selection key will become invalid and you can only press the down selection key when entering again
When adjusting the music volume on the settings interface, the conversation volume will also be adjusted along with it
7. New game starts, "failure compensation" ability does not take effect properly
8. The issue of not synchronizing the actual and displayed values on the skill page
9. In controller mode, the key prompt for unlocking the crystal is the keyboard and mouse
10. The issue of BGM pausing when the page is opened
Map adjustment:
1. Raven Village decryption level adjustment to prevent inability to leave normally
2. Some agencies may cause stuttering issues due to sudden advances
3. On the way to the illusion maze in Crow Village, there may be a problem with the mechanism getting stuck
4. Fix some map art texture errors
5. The lack of corresponding abilities after completing the volcano will lead to checkpoint issues if it cannot pass
6. Fixed the issue of some areas being unable to attack normally
Other adjustments:
1. Partial sound effect replacement and adjustment
2. Improved rewards provided after killing enemies
3. Improved visual differences in dialogue options
